189031335.title: File:DFC 4374 Freshly cut kabocha squash revealing its vibrant orange flesh and seeds ready for market or the kitchen.jpg

ObjectName.value: DFC 4374 Freshly cut kabocha squash revealing its vibrant orange flesh and seeds ready for market or the kitchen

Categories.value: Files with coordinates missing SDC location of creation|Flickr images reviewed by FlickreviewR 2|Khet Udomsak

ImageDescription.value: The photo shows freshly cut pumpkin or squash pieces with bright orange flesh and yellow-orange interior. The squash has been cut to reveal the inner fibrous portion and seeds in the center. The outer skin appears rough and textured with a green-brown coloration. In the background, there are what look like whole green papayas or similar tropical fruits. The produce appears to be displayed on what might be a blue textured surface or cloth, suggesting this could be at a market or food preparation area. This appears to be tropical produce typical of Thailand, consistent with the photo's location in Sattahip, Chon Buri Province.

202447111.title: File:DFC 6141 Freshly cut local pumpkin wedges from Klet Kaeo Sattahip - bright golden flesh and seeds ready for cooking.jpg

ObjectName.value: DFC 6141 Freshly cut local pumpkin wedges from Klet Kaeo Sattahip - bright golden flesh and seeds ready for cooking

Categories.value: Thailand|Chonburi Province|Sattahip District|Files with coordinates missing SDC location of creation|Flickr images reviewed by FlickreviewR 2|Klet Kaeo

ImageDescription.value: This close-up photograph showcases freshly cut wedges of kabocha squash (Japanese pumpkin), revealing their vibrant golden-yellow flesh and dark green outer rind. The squash pieces display the characteristic hollow center filled with pale cream-colored seeds and stringy fibrous pulp. The thick, dense flesh has a smooth texture that contrasts beautifully with the rough, mottled dark skin. The wedges are arranged on what appears to be a blue and white checkered cloth or surface, which provides a classic, rustic backdrop that enhances the warm tones of the squash. The lighting highlights the rich colors and natural textures, making this a visually appealing shot that captures a common ingredient used in Thai cuisine, where kabocha (known locally as "fak thong") is popular in curries, desserts, and stir-fries.
